question: (1)/(20) is what percentage of (11)/(90) (rounded off to two decimal places)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required Ratio = (1 ÷ 20) ÷ (11 ÷ 90)

= (1 ÷ 20) × (90 ÷ 11)

= 90 ÷ 220 = 9 ÷ 22

= 0.40909... ≈ 0.4091

**∴ Answer = 0.4091**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First fraction = 1/20

Second fraction = 11/90

**Formula used:**

Value = (First Number ÷ Second Number)

 
• Total: 11/90 (Represented as 22 units) Part: 1/20 (Represented as 9 units) Ratio = 9 ÷ 22 ≈ 0.4091 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Required Result = (1/20) ÷ (11/90)

⇒ Result = (1/20) × (90/11)

⇒ Result = 90 ÷ 220

⇒ Result = 9 ÷ 22

⇒ Result = 0.4090909...

⇒ Result ≈ 0.4091

**∴ The correct answer is 0.4091 (Option 3).**
